archetypes.name: drafter-argv
archetypes.rationale: Drafter CLI parity depends on exact child argv, sentinel, and status sidecar behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new Codex and Claude drafter launchers for exact argv shape, validation parity, and status sidecar contracts. Pay close attention to timeout handling, prompt containment, symlink rejection, token records, and scout manifest promotion. Check that Python behavior matches the retired shell launchers without adding compatibility shims. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: diagnostics-parity
archetypes.rationale: Shared stderr-tail and vendor diagnostics changes affect multiple external-agent failure paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review failure diagnostic collection across run_external_agent, CI fixers, collectors, and drafter failures. Verify carrier ordering, byte caps, redaction boundaries, retry-source precedence, and stale sidecar cleanup. Look for regressions where diagnostics are over-redacted, under-redacted, truncated incorrectly, or selected from the wrong source. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
